text:
ana-s: Heads up - customer acct42 reports embeddings size changed after we pushed a pinned variant. They saw 512 vectors, expected 768.
customer-acct42: yep, started seeing issues after last night's deploy, our similarity searches break.
support-bot: Ticket #INC-8421 created.
devin: Can you paste a failing request/response? quick curl pls.
customer-acct42: here:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-2024-v2","input":"hello"}'
```
response (truncated):
```
{ "data": [[0.123, ... ]], "model": "rwd-embed-2024-v2-quant", "embedding_size": 512 }
```
marta: interesting — model in response is the quant variant. someone may have routed pinned traffic to a smaller-vec variant during canary.
ajay: checking model catalog + routing logs. quick check: /internal/models/rwd-embed-2024-v2 returned:
```
{"id":"rwd-embed-2024-v2","variants":[{"id":"rwd-embed-2024-v2-quant","embedding_size":512},{"id":"rwd-embed-2024-v2","embedding_size":768}]}
```
ajay: route table shows pinned model -> policy matched label `fast-quant` for some pods due to incomplete selector. reproducing now.
devin: Steps for customer to validate locally:
1) Call GET /v1/models/rwd-embed-2024-v2
2) Check `embedding_size` field and `model` returned in embeddings response
3) If model name ends with `-quant`, vectors will be 512.
ana-s: proposing short-term fix: rollback canary mapping and force pin to exact variant id `rwd-embed-2024-v2@sha256:abc123`.
marta: also adding a server-side check: warn if embedding_size != expected for tenant's pinned model and surface in Console.
customer-acct42: appreciate it, can you do rollback? our production similarity is down.
devin: starting rollback now, will ping when done :rocket: 
support-bot: Deployment rollback job started by devin.
ajay: rollback finished, verified responses now show embedding_size=768 for sample requests.
customer-acct42: confirming on our end — all good, similarity scores restored. thanks!
marta: follow-up action: create a ticket to prevent selector fallthrough in routing logic, add an integration test that asserts variant stability for pinned models.
nana-s: thanks everyone. closing thread after we create the follow-up Jira.
